llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only prompt-architecture playbook and appears internally consistent. Before installing or using it, consider: (1) it may ask you to paste client briefs, screenshots, or URLs—do not paste private analytics, credentials, or sensitive customer data unless you intend to share them; (2) the generator prompt requests outputs/analysis in Chinese for structure/analysis—confirm this language requirement fits your workflow; (3) if you enable live browsing or give the agent access to a website, limit that access to public pages only; (4) autonomous invocation is allowed by default on the platform (disable-model-invocation would be a platform-level control), so be mindful of how you permit the agent to call this skill. Overall the skill is coherent with its stated purpose and contains no disproportionate requirements.
